Executive Summary We propose an AI-driven education portal for JEE/GATE/NEET that offers automatically generated video lectures, topic-wise notes, quizzes, and question banks, supported by teacher and administrator interfaces. All content will be strictly constrained to the relevant syllabus through a layered safety system (rules, classifiers, and possible reinforcement learning fine-tuning) to prevent off-topic or inappropriate output. Roadmap & Implementation Phases We propose a phased rollout with roughly 3 phases over ~24–30 months: • Phase 1 – Planning & Prototype (0–6 mo): • Milestones: Requirements gathering, architecture design, initial prototyping. • Activities: Collect core curriculum data; build basic platform skeleton (user accounts, simple CMS); prototype LLM summarization and Q&A with small models; test video pipeline with manual slide decks. • Team: Project Manager, 2 ML engineers, 2 software engineers, 1 subject expert, 1 DevOps. • Phase 2 – MVP Development (6–15 mo): • Milestones: Develop core AI modules and UI for students/teachers. • Activities: Train/fine-tune models
